answers.answer: The team initially considered targeting the sixteen to forty-five age range for its size and potential profit, but decided to focus on the sixty to eighty age group because the remote required a simple, user-friendly design and this older demographic tended to spend money more easily. To address the resulting conflict with initial marketing goals, the team decided to maintain design simplicity while using interchangeable covers to appeal to younger users.
